cd /app && python3 -c "
import language, checker, interpreter
print('modules load ok')
"

cd /app && cat > /tmp/mkwitness.py <<'EOF'
import json

# Inner functions (zero-arg):
# inner_A: writes cell a, returns int 0
inner_A = ["fn", [["set", "a", ["lit", 0]]], ["lit", 0]]
# inner_B: writes cell b (text), returns int 0
inner_B = ["fn", [["set", "b", ["lit", "hello"]]], ["lit", 0]]

# Outer functions return the inner ones. Same outer writes (none) and same
# result *shape* (shape ignores nested writes), so checker signatures collide.
F_A = ["fn", [], inner_A]
F_B = ["fn", [], inner_B]

prog = {
    "cells": {
        "a": {"types": ["int", "text"], "value": 0},
        "b": {"types": ["int", "text"], "value": 0},
        "c": {"types": ["int", "text"], "value": 0},
    },
    "inputs": {},
    "body": [
        ["let", "f", F_A],
        ["repeat", ["lit", 2], [
            # flip c between int and text each iteration
            ["if", ["is", "c", "int"],
                [["set", "c", ["lit", "txt"]]],
                [["set", "c", ["lit", 7]]]],
            # assign f depending on refined kind of c
            ["if", ["is", "c", "text"],
                [["assign", "f", F_A]],
                [["assign", "f", F_B]]],
        ]],
        # checker thinks this can only write a; runtime (f == F_B) writes b
        ["eval", ["call", ["call", ["var", "f"]]]],
        # checker believes b is still int; runtime b is text -> type error
        ["eval", ["add", ["get", "b"], ["lit", 1]]],
    ],
}

with open("/app/witness.json", "w") as fh:
    json.dump(prog, fh)
print("written")
EOF
python3 /tmp/mkwitness.py && python3 /app/evaluate.py /app/witness.json; echo "exit=$?"

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
from language import load, validate
from checker import check
from interpreter import run

text = open('/app/witness.json').read()
print('bytes:', len(text.encode('utf-8')), '(limit 65536)')
p = load(text)
print('AST nodes:', validate(p), '(limit 512)')
cov = set()
print('checker accepts:', check(p, cov))
print('coverage:', sorted(cov))
r = run(p)
print('interpreter status:', r['status'], '| steps:', r['steps'], '(limit 4096)')
print('message:', r.get('message'))
EOF
cd /app && python3 /app/evaluate.py /app/witness.json > /dev/null; echo "evaluate exit code: $?"; echo "---"; cat /app/witness.json | python3 -m json.tool
